name: Slayerdramon
main_effect:
＜Piercing＞ (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash any 3 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, delete 1 of their Digimon with no digivolution cards.
[All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When your opponent's security stack is removed from, 1 of your Digimon with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in its text may unsuspend.
source_effect: [All Turns] [Once Per Turn] When any of your Digimon with [Dracomon] or [Examon] in their texts would leave the battle area other than in battle, by suspending this Digimon, they don't leave.
